stats.attacks.name: Black Cloud
stats.attacks.notes: By spending 2 FP and performing a Ready maneuver, an achaierai can release a choking, toxic black cloud. It spreads in a 2-yard radius area around the achaierai, lasts 10 seconds, and drifts with the wind. The cloud imposes a -3 penalty on all vision- and Infravision-based rolls within the area. Additionally, every creature that inhales the cloud must make an HT roll. If it fails, it takes 1d toxic damage, ignoring DR, and begins to hallucinate for margin of failure minutes. After that the subject is stunned (p. B420) and may roll vs. HT once per second to recover. Achaierais are immune to this ability.

stats.attacks.name: Kiss
stats.attacks.damage: A vargouille can kiss a target by making a successful unarmed attack against the target’s unprotected face. An affected opponent must succeed on a HT roll or begin a terrible transformation that turns the creature into a vargouille within 24 hours (and often much sooner; roll 1d separately for each phase of the transformation). First, over a period of 1d hours, all the victim’s hair falls out. Within another 1d hours thereafter, the ears grow into leathery wings, tentacles sprout on the chin and scalp, and the teeth become long, pointed fangs. During the next 1d hours, the victim takes loses 1 IQ each hour (maximum 3). The transformation is complete 1d hours later, when the subject experiences a heart attack and, if not resuscitated, the head breaks free of the body (which promptly dies) and becomes a vargouille. This transformation is interrupted by sunlight (it can delay death), but to reverse the transformation requires Cure Disease at -3 or Remove Curse. Dispel Magic will not lift this effect
